messages:
Maya: pulled together BrightBridge onboarding feedback — 21 asks total: UI toggles, two security blockers, and several integration gaps. full list: https://docs.internal/redwood/brightbridge-onboard-asks
Alex: quick skim: ~12 minor UI tweaks, 4 flow/UX items, 5 infra/integration (SSO, token rotation, billing webhook, schema mismatch, csv import).
Sam: renewal status: warm but at-risk if the two security blockers aren't addressed before next sync. need clear BTWN blockers vs backlog.
Maya: blockers called out by customer: SSO attribute mapping (prevents team mapping to roles) and per-account token rotation flow. both break their prod sync.
Jordan: marking SSO mapping P0; token rotation P1 but high compliance risk (finance/legal care).
Alex: mitigation idea: add a CSV mapping importer in console as short-term patch; longer term: heuristic auto-mapper with preview.
Sam: can we get rough eng estimates? if <3 dev-weeks we can slot into next sprint commit.
Maya: propose a consistent triage formula to make these calls reproducible:
```
priority = impact(1-5)*frequency(1-5) + severity(1-3)*2
// impact = customer-visible business impact, frequency = how often telemetry shows the issue
```
Liam: for frequency we need sample events. i can run queries if someone drops example logs or a sample csv from their import.
Maya: uploaded a csv excerpt + two example error events to the doc. top errors: mapping_missing, mapping_conflict.
product-ops: note: any customer-facing workaround copy needs to go through support templates. keep fallback messaging consistent.
Alex: i'll own the CSV importer spike: 1 day spike, 3 days build if clean. will estimate more after spike.
Jordan: i'll draft enablement steps and a runbook for CS to guide the BrightBridge teams through the CSV workaround.
Sara: billing ask (cost per-route breakdown) flagged in list — finance will share sample calc and api endpoints; tagging FYI.
Sam: owners check: Sam = prioritization & risk call, Alex = CSV band-aid owner, Liam = telemetry numbers, Jordan = enablement/runbook, Sara = billing artifacts. Maya to keep tracker up to date.
Maya: noted. will update tracker and send a brief customer message outlining plan & mitigations. aiming for owners + initial estimates by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
Alex: keeping workaround opt-in and reversible.
Liam: ping me after the csv snippet is live; i'll run frequency queries and share numbers.
Maya: closing the thread for now — will repost with ETA table on Friday and link to the tracker: https://tracker.internal/redwood/onboard-asks
